description: This file implements PHP4 session management using the ADODB database abstraction layer, with encryption for session data.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class used for encrypting and decrypting session data, imported from 'crypt.inc.php'.

methods.name: ADODB_Session_Key
methods.description: Creates an encryption key for crypted sessions by crypting a static key with the current session ID.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes and opens a database connection for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database, decrypting the data.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, encrypting it.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a session record from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions.
